description: Colladew is a Korean injectable collagen product built around high-purity atelocollagen rather than hyaluronic acid. It is used to replenish and support the skin's own collagen scaffold, improving skin quality, firmness and fine surface texture. It is positioned as a collagen-replenishing skinbooster/soft-tissue supplement rather than a purely volumising cross-linked HA filler.
howItWorks: Atelocollagen is collagen from which the immunogenic telopeptide components have been removed, making it highly biocompatible and close to the collagen naturally found in skin. Once placed in the dermis it provides an immediate collagen scaffold and supports fibroblast activity and cell migration, helping the skin rebuild and maintain its own collagen matrix over time for improved elasticity and texture.
composition: Atelocollagen 3% (purified animal/fish-derived collagen with immunogenic components removed); supplied as a 1 mL prefilled syringe.
usageNotes: Injected into the dermal layer by a trained practitioner; supplied prefilled with needles. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze. Confirm suitability for patients with known collagen or protein sensitivities before treatment.
features: High-purity collagen with immunogenic components removed
benefits: Differentiated collagen SKU alongside HA and PN boosters
Addresses skin firmness and texture, not just volume
Prefilled format streamlines chairside preparation
Supports course-based, repeat-visit treatment plans
Broadens a clinic's regenerative treatment menu
indications: Loss of skin firmness and elasticity
Collagen replenishment after ageing or procedures

description: Kiara Reju is a Korean polynucleotide (PDRN) rejuvenation skinbooster that combines salmon-derived PDRN with non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid and niacinamide. It is designed to regenerate and hydrate the skin while soothing post-procedure inflammation, rather than to add volume. It is positioned as a triple-active biorevitalisation booster for overall skin quality.
howItWorks: The PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) fraction supports tissue repair and stimulates fibroblast activity, promoting regeneration of collagen and extracellular-matrix components over successive weeks. The non-cross-linked hyaluronic acid draws water into the dermis for immediate hydration and elasticity, while niacinamide contributes anti-inflammatory and brightening effects that help calm the skin after injection.
composition: Hyaluronic acid 20 mg/mL, PDRN 5 mg/mL and niacinamide 1 mg/mL; supplied as 2.2 mL prefilled syringes (commonly a 3-syringe pack).
usageNotes: Delivered by dermal microinjection, typically as a course of sessions spaced roughly 3-4 weeks apart per practitioner protocol. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze. For professional use by trained aesthetic practitioners only.
features: Triple active: PDRN + non-cross-linked HA + niacinamide
benefits: Combined regeneration and hydration in a single SKU
Niacinamide supports smoother post-treatment recovery
Prefilled format streamlines chairside preparation
Course-based protocol drives recurring visits
Complements, rather than competes with, HA fillers
indications: Fine lines and early signs of ageing

description: Lip Sul is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler designed specifically for the lips. It is engineered for high viscoelasticity and biocompatibility so that it integrates softly and moves naturally with expression. It is a lip-volumising and lip-contouring HA filler, not a skinbooster.
howItWorks: As a cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel, Lip Sul adds structural volume and definition when placed into the lip tissue. The cross-linked HA binds water to create and hold plumpness and shape, while the gel's network-structure design is intended to give flexible, natural movement and gradual, even resorption over time.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel (high-concentration HA) using a network-structure control technology (marketed as DQ Fill). Exact HA concentration not published on reviewed sources.
usageNotes: For intra-lip injection by a trained practitioner; a Class-IV-type injectable medical device for clinical use only. Keep hyaluronidase available on site to dissolve HA in the event of vascular compromise or an unsatisfactory result. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Cross-linked HA filler dedicated to lip enhancement
High viscoelasticity for natural lip movement
Designed for soft tissue integration and definition
benefits: Purpose-built lip SKU for aesthetic menus
Natural-movement positioning suits conservative lip work
HA chemistry allows correction/reversal if needed
Supports lip volume and border-definition cases
Broadens a clinic's HA lip filler range
indications: Age- or genetics-related lip volume loss

description: Lip Star is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid lip filler infused with an anthocyanin antioxidant to enhance both volume and lip colour. It is designed to create fuller, defined, naturally rosy lips while supporting moisture retention. It is a lip HA filler, not a skinbooster.
howItWorks: The cross-linked hyaluronic acid provides structural volume and definition and binds water to hold plumpness in the lip tissue. The added anthocyanin, a plant-derived antioxidant pigment, is intended to lend a natural red/rosy tint and antioxidant support, complementing the HA's hydrating and volumising action.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 24 mg/mL and anthocyanin 1 mg/mL; supplied as a 1.2 mL syringe.
usageNotes: For intra-lip injection by a trained practitioner. Keep hyaluronidase available on site to dissolve HA in the event of vascular compromise or an unsatisfactory result. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze. Note colour-tint claims relate to the anthocyanin component.
features: Cross-linked HA lip filler with anthocyanin
benefits: Combines lip volume with natural colour enhancement
Differentiated 'red lip' SKU for aesthetic menus
HA chemistry allows correction/reversal if needed
Appeals to patients wanting subtle tint plus volume
Broadens a clinic's HA lip filler range

description: Priere Lip is a Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid lip filler formulated for fuller, well-defined lips with natural colour and durability. It blends low- and high-molecular-weight HA in a monophasic gel and includes lidocaine for patient comfort. It is a lip HA filler, not a skinbooster.
howItWorks: The cross-linked hyaluronic acid adds structural volume and shape and binds water to maintain lip plumpness. Blending low- and high-molecular-weight HA into a monophasic gel is intended to improve uniformity and resistance to enzymatic breakdown for longer-lasting, even results, while incorporated lidocaine reduces discomfort during and after injection.
composition: Cross-linked hyaluronic acid 26 mg/mL with lidocaine HCl 3 mg/mL (monophasic blend of low- and high-molecular-weight HA, BDDE cross-linked); supplied as a 1.1 mL syringe.
usageNotes: For intra-lip injection by a trained practitioner; contains lidocaine, so confirm no amide-anaesthetic sensitivity. Keep hyaluronidase available on site to dissolve HA in the event of vascular compromise or an unsatisfactory result. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze.
features: Cross-linked HA lip filler with lidocaine
Monophasic blend of low- and high-molecular-weight HA
benefits: Built-in lidocaine improves patient comfort
Monophasic gel positioned for even, durable results
HA chemistry allows correction/reversal if needed
Suits both volume and definition lip cases
Broadens a clinic's HA lip filler range
indications: Age- or genetics-related lip volume loss

description: Mayster is a Korean collagen-stimulating skinbooster from Maypharm built around poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA). Rather than adding immediate volume, it works gradually to rebuild the skin's collagen support structure, restoring firmness and elasticity. It is positioned as a biostimulatory collagen booster reconstituted with an activator solution before use.
howItWorks: PLLA microparticles act as a biostimulator: once placed in the tissue they trigger a controlled fibroblast response, and as the PLLA is gradually resorbed the initial inflammatory phase subsides while new collagen production continues, strengthening and thickening the skin's structural matrix over the following months. The accompanying activator provides hyaluronic acid, amino acids and peptides to support hydration and handling.
composition: Poly-L-lactic acid (PLLA) micro-powder (approximately 100 mg) reconstituted with an activator (approximately 5 mL) containing hyaluronic acid, amino acids and peptides. A combined Mayster set variant also pairs PLLA with HA and PDRN.
usageNotes: Must be administered only by a licensed physician trained in the Mayster technique; requires reconstitution with the activator prior to injection. A typical course is 2-3 sessions spaced roughly 3-5 weeks apart. Advise patients to avoid saunas, hot baths, alcohol and intense exercise for around two weeks after treatment. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions; do not freeze.
features: Supplied with a dedicated activator (HA, amino acids, peptides)
Available as a combined PLLA/HA/PDRN set variant
benefits: Biostimulatory action addresses firmness and elasticity
Distinct from HA fillers on the treatment menu
Course-based protocol drives recurring visits
Verified manufacturer supports supply confidence
Positioned for progressive, natural-looking rejuvenation
indications: Loss of skin firmness and elasticity

description: Hanheal HA is a Korean hyaluronic acid skinbooster from BNC Global based on high-molecular-weight, non-cross-linked sodium hyaluronate. It is designed to deeply hydrate the skin and deliver a smoothing, hydro-lifting effect rather than to add structural volume. It is positioned as a hydration-focused skin-quality booster.
howItWorks: The high-molecular-weight, non-cross-linked hyaluronate binds and holds large amounts of water in the dermis, replenishing the skin's water balance for immediate hydration, improved elasticity and a plumping, smoothing effect. Sustained hydration and dermal support are also intended to encourage the skin's own collagen synthesis over time.
composition: Sodium hyaluronate (non-cross-linked) at approximately 1.7% concentration, high molecular weight (around 1 million daltons); supplied as 5 mL vials (commonly a 5-vial pack).
usageNotes: Delivered by dermal microinjection, mesotherapy or with an injector gun, typically as a course of sessions per practitioner protocol. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze. For professional use by trained aesthetic practitioners only.
features: 5 mL vial format for larger treatment areas
benefits: Strong hydration and skin-quality positioning
Larger 5 mL vial suits full-face and multi-area work
Complements, rather than competes with, HA fillers
Course-based protocol drives recurring visits
Verified manufacturer supports supply confidence

description: Hanheal PDRN is a Korean polynucleotide (PDRN) skinbooster from BNC Global that pairs salmon-derived PDRN with a broad multi-nutrient complex including hyaluronic acid, vitamins, peptides, amino acids and minerals. It is designed for skin regeneration, repair and hydration rather than volumising. It is positioned as a regenerative, nutrient-rich skin-quality booster.
howItWorks: The salmon-derived PDRN (polydeoxyribonucleotide) supports tissue repair and stimulates fibroblast activity, promoting collagen synthesis and improved skin texture and tone over successive weeks. The accompanying complex of hyaluronic acid, vitamins, amino acids, peptides and minerals provides hydration and nutritional support, while PDRN's soothing properties help calm sensitive or irritated skin.
composition: Salmon-derived PDRN combined with a multi-component complex including hyaluronic acid, vitamins, growth-factor peptides, amino acids, coenzymes, minerals and antioxidants; supplied as 5 mL vials (commonly a 5-vial pack).
usageNotes: Delivered by dermal microinjection or mesotherapy, typically as a course of sessions spaced per practitioner protocol. Store per the manufacturer's instructions in cool, dry conditions away from direct sunlight; do not freeze. For professional use by trained aesthetic practitioners only.
